title: Chapter 834
paragraphs: Chapter 834
Episode 209. Temar's Seventh Tomb - Keytum's Picture (7)
Jin and Murakan.
The two were the first to feel the presence of the fake.
"Knights, he is coming."
"It's the fake one. I was worried about what would happen if he ravaged other regions again, but thankfully, he is coming here to die."
The Ten Knights also heightened their senses and recognized the power of the fake.
"All knights in the castle, assemble. It is the day of the decisive battle."
"We must execute him today, to wash away the governor's resentment..."
"Barmel, Murakan. Show us your skills."

As soon as the fake appeared in the nearby airspace, the storm became more intense and the night darkened even more. It was as if not a dragon, but a wicked god had descended here to destroy this place.
The Ten Knights were busy directing the other knights.
"...He's strong. Seems like the one that Keytum drew really is you at your peak. Even though he's quite a distance away, we can clearly feel his immense power."
"Humph! But it's just a fake, nothing more than a picture."
"Judging by what you're saying, you must also feel that he's quite powerful, right?"
"Of course, I, the real one, was even stronger than that, but yes. He's dangerous. We must be alert, kid."
When they went outside, the knights were already arranged.
Even among the lowest-ranking knights, none were succumbed to fear. Everyone was ready to fight with the determination to face death.
Jin and Murakan climbed to the top of the castle gate.
"As you know, there's no way to fight him while he's in the air."
"He swept through Lugado and Mito, so he would know about Murakan and me. He'll be within range soon."
Swooosh......
Jin slowly drew Sigmund. In the moonless storm, the pale blade quietly shimmered.

"We need to bring him down to the ground, focusing on me and the kid. Frey, you will support from a distance until the ground battle begins, then charge in with the knights. Dranak and Violro will join us in close-quarters combat in the air."
The Ten Knights nodded.
"Barmel, Murakan."
"Speak, Knight Frey."
"Why?"
"I regret not being able to welcome you both properly at first, and now such a big fight is about to start, I feel sorry."
Now, the Storm Castle fully trusted Jin and Murakan.

Only those truly enraged by this incident, those who could die for Run Kandel, could emit such a fighting spirit towards the dark sky like these two. Such an intense fighting spirit that seemed to overpower and tear apart anything.
"There's no need for that."
"Also, I'm glad you two are here. Looking at it now, we wouldn't have been able to handle him on our own."
"As I said, there's no need for disappointment. It's an honor to fight alongside the knights."
"We feel the same."
The moment Frey responded.
Suddenly, a black whirlpool occurred in the middle of the sky where Run Kandel was looking. It was the breath exhaled by the fake.
"Hup!"
At the same time, Murakan leaned back and clenched his fist. His fists and legs were covered in black dragon scales, and with a single step forward, one side of the castle wall crumbled.
"Eurgh!"
The fist he thrust forward emitted an enormous and sharp spirit, like breath. In the air, two streaks of spirit collided and distorted the space.
Before the scattered spirits could revert to their original state, Murakan transformed into his true form and surrounded the entire castle with a black barrier.
[Are you ready to pay for impersonating me, harming Temar, and killing so many people without reason, you transient existence formed from lies.]
Upon hearing these words, the fake stopped in mid-air and stared at Murakan.
'That bastard is bigger than Murakan...'
The huge bodies of the two black dragons seemed to fill the sky. They looked exactly the same, but at first glance, the fake, which was bigger, exuded a more intimidating atmosphere.
[So it was true what the creatures of Mito said. There is an existence that looks just like me... That power, quite impressive. Who made you?]
[This kid still thinks he's the real one. Let's skip the long talk. Once he gets hit, he'll realize, 'Ah, I'm the fake, I'm a worthless insect.']

[Do you think it's possible to do that without Temar Run Kandel? There's no one among you who can kill me. Just hand over Barisada obediently, and I'll spare your lives. Especially the fake, I think you'll be useful for a long time...]
Szzz-!
Just as the fake was about to finish his words, it cut through the storm from the castle wall. The falling rain evaporated in the cyan thunder, leaving an afterimage.
The fifth secret technique, Light Speed Stab, the King. Seven streams of sword aura bisected the black sky and rushed towards the fake.
The fake was already shielding himself, so six of them were blocked, but the last sword aura, which was shot in layers, pierced through the gap into the fake's chest.
The spirit poured out like blood from the deeply carved wound.
But the spirit fell to the ground and was quickly restored back to the fake.
"It's not just simple rapid regeneration. Is it that there's no impact on the absolute amount of spirit energy constituting the fake...."
-In my prime, even if this little one and I both attacked, there would be no chance of winning.
-Really? Is it that serious? Didn't you say you're close to your prime?

-Being close and being complete are different. Heh heh. Back in the day, this Murakan, if you weren't a sovereign, you couldn't kill him. You just couldn't. No matter how many strong ones gathered, if there weren't a sovereign among them, they couldn't kill him.
The words Murakan had said before entering the painting came to mind after the first blow.
Indeed, Jin felt like he was hitting the ocean, as Murakan said. No matter how large the trace he left on the water, the sea quickly regained its form.
Jin thought of things he possessed that could effectively strike the fake.
'Immortal Flame, Ascending Flame, The Sword of Myeongwang Dominance and the ultimate form of the Destruction Flame Jewel of the Demon Emperor, the Five Techniques of the Family.'

Among them, he decided to save the Immortal Flame for the last and use it when he could surely aim at the heart. He judged that the Immortal Flame was the closest to the characteristic of 'Sovereign.'
[A knight I've never seen before. I didn't know that Temar had hidden such a descendant.]
"Even Lord Temar would not know."
[Is that so? You seem to be using the power of the Myeongwang, you must have been at Laprarosa.]
"You don't need to know about me. Because we can't coexist under one sky."
The fake couldn't understand that those words imply the world within the painting and snickered.
[That's when I wish to be so. I'm interested in you. I should keep you alive, I have much to investigate.]
Bang!
Murakan bit the neck of the fake by sticking close to him. The fake also bit Murakan's neck at the same time, both of them holding their breaths in their mouths.

Their breaths exploded, and for a moment, the heads of the two dragons were covered by the spirit energy each spat out. Their heads and necks seemed to have exploded altogether, but neither was greatly damaged.

And Jin and the ten knights surrounded the fake in an instant, riding on the sword wind. The swords of Dranax and Viola first tore the multi-layered curtain, and Jin entered into it and approached the fake.
With the 9 Sword of Devastation, the sword energy spread like wings and cut down the fake's wings. Then, the 7 Sword Dragon Killer targeted the chest, and Meteor Shower aimed for the back.

Especially, the Dragon Killer of the God Killer series is a sword specialized for dragons. The hook-shaped dark sword energy incessantly dug and slashed the scales on the chest. It was visible that the fake, suffering, paid attention to the Dragon Killer and slowly blocked other attacks.

'There's no damage, but it seems to feel pain. Or it consumes mental energy to restore through the spirit energy conversion, anyway, the fake tries to avoid the attack as much as possible. I can pull it down to the ground.'

Even while the two dragons were entangled and rotating, Jin and the ten knights accurately attacked only the fake. This was possible only for the top-tier superhumans. Originally, if it weren't for them, they couldn't even withstand the breaths and spirit energy constantly spat out by the two black dragons.
Storm Castle was also ready to attack the imposter. There were thick, giant spears made from ancient permafrost iron next to Frei, and she was holding one, carefully aiming at the imposter.
'Now is the time.'
Thud, whack-!
When Frei threw her spear with all her might, the castle floor crumbled, and a shockwave spread. The spear shot upwards left a dazzling trail in the black sky, accurately hitting the imposter's head.
Before the imposter could look in Frei's direction, she was already throwing a new spear. Each time the spear hit him, a heavy vibration echoed across the battlefield.
Little by little, the altitude of the imposter Murakan was decreasing. The imposter spewed black spikes from his body, pushing away Jin and the ten knights who were trying to get close.

However, the three of them cut and smashed the spikes with their swords, persistently clinging to different parts of the imposter's body. They jammed a sword into his neck, tore his wing membranes, and exploded aura and magic in his abdomen. In the process, they themselves also got various wounds.
From the start, the situation was intense, and the first to achieve their goal was Jin's group. After a close fight, Murakan was able to climb onto the imposter's back.

With his teeth lodged into the imposter's neck, Murakan constantly beat the imposter's shoulders and wings with both his front paws. He formed spikes from his two wings, constantly poking the imposter's flank. The imposter's scales, flesh, bones, and organs were being shattered and dispersed as aura.
They were also being restored. Even though they were causing pain, no essential damage was being done.
"Get off!"

Dragnaks exerted force, plunging his sword into the shoulder that Frei's spear had penetrated. The spear broke and further dug into the imposter's wound, and Violro cut off the spikes aimed at Dragnaks and Jin.

Even if the imposter was perfectly replicating Murakan in his prime, without transforming, it seemed impossible for him to escape this state. With the knights and Murakan constantly neutralizing the spikes dispersed as aura by the imposter and continuing their pressure, it was structurally limited for him to simply escape.
Eventually, the imposter momentarily turned into a human and positioned himself on the ground, on a mountain slope. Jin, Dragnaks, and Violro fell like lightning, swinging their swords.
However, the next moment, all three simultaneously halted their action, creating a sword wind. They instinctively sensed danger and deviated from their descent path.
At that sight, the imposter smirked.
"Do you think that if you pull me to the ground, something will happen? Especially the imposter, you were the most desperate. Probably because you know me well."
[You're driving me crazy, who are you calling an imposter? You're out of your mind, you got hit too little.]
"Right... Come to think of it, you guys were more upset when someone other than you got hurt. Then, let's start by smashing Storm Castle. After all, Varisada is there too."
As the imposter said that, he reached out towards where Storm Castle was.
"This is how you use aura, imposter. And imposter contractor."
At that moment, including the top of the Murakan Mountain where Storm Castle was, the entire mountain range was dyed black with aura.
And the knights waiting in Storm Castle were verifying that the shadows placed beneath their feet were strangely distorting.
Almost all the shadows in various places of Storm Castle were distorting like that. Those who were distorted by his power, their shadows were becoming the same as the distorted shapes.
